final: WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals), combinations AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) - (SELECT avg_optvolrt FROM baseline) AS deviation, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), compared AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, avg_optvolrt, deviation, deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS excess FROM combinations WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT * FROM compared WHERE deviation > deviation - excess) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind
